text: In nineteen fifteen, Russia built a tank shaped like a giant tricycle. Its front wheels were nine metres tall. The idea: wheels that big would roll right over trenches and trees. But the small rear wheel took far too much of the weight. On its first trial, the rear wheel sank into soft ground. The giant front wheels couldn't pull it out. The project was cancelled. The tank sat stuck in the forest for years, and was scrapped in nineteen twenty-three. Dave went round the back to push.
